name: @laticent/calco
description: Rendered slides to office documents you can edit. A reader turns a laid-out HTML slide into text frames (font, size, color, line breaks as the browser drew them) and hides that text for a clean background photo; writers turn the result into an OpenDocument Presentation (.odp, fonts embedded) or a PowerPoint (.pptx) with real text boxes over each slide's picture, plus speaker notes and alt text. No dependencies: JSZip, PptxGenJS and the font pinner are passed in.
author: Sharmarke Aden (Laticent) <sharmarke.aden@gmail.com>
